from build123d import *

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions (mm)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# overall envelope
length = 80.0          # X : overall length of the channel
height = 40.0          # Y : overall height of the channel
width = 35.0           # Z : overall width of the channel

# wall thicknesses
t_web = 5.0            # web (back) wall thickness
t_bottom = 5.0         # bottom wall thickness
t_top = 5.0            # top wall thickness

# step geometry
step_x = 20.0          # X position of the step (from the left end)
step_y = 20.0          # Y position of the step (from the bottom)

# rounded internal corners
r_web_bottom = 5.0     # web / bottom junction
r_web_step = 6.0       # web / step junction
r_step_top = 4.0       # step / top junction
r_top_right = 3.0      # top / right end junction
r_bottom_right = 2.5   # bottom / right end junction

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the channel profile (X-Y plane) and extrude it along Z
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        with BuildLine():
            # ---- outer profile (counter-clockwise) ----
            Line((0.0, 0.0), (length, 0.0))                       # bottom edge
            Line((length, 0.0), (length, height))                 # right end edge
            Line((length, height), (step_x, height))              # top edge
            Line((step_x, height), (step_x, step_y))              # step edge
            Line((step_x, step_y), (0.0, step_y))                 # step shoulder
            Line((0.0, step_y), (0.0, 0.0))                       # web edge

            # ---- rounded internal corners ----
            ThreePointArc((0.0, 0.0),
                          (r_web_bottom, r_web_bottom),
                          (r_web_bottom, step_y))                 # web / bottom
            ThreePointArc((r_web_bottom, step_y),
                          (r_web_step, step_y + r_web_step),
                          (step_x, step_y + r_web_step))          # web / step
            ThreePointArc((step_x, step_y + r_web_step),
                          (step_x + r_step_top, height - r_step_top),
                          (step_x + r_step_top, height))          # step / top
            ThreePointArc((step_x + r_step_top, height),
                          (length - r_top_right, height - r_top_right),
                          (length, height - r_top_right))         # top / right
            ThreePointArc((length, height - r_top_right),
                          (length - r_bottom_right, r_bottom_right),
                          (length - r_bottom_right, 0.0))         # bottom / right

        make_face()
    extrude(amount=width)

part = p.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# One-piece tapered housing shell (open-ended tube, no separate boss)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
overall_length = 80.0          # mm, axial length of the housing
inlet_width = 45.0             # mm, inlet opening width
inlet_height = 20.0            # mm, inlet opening height
outlet_width = 30.0            # mm, outlet opening width
outlet_height = 12.0           # mm, outlet opening height
wall_thickness = 3.0           # mm, nominal shell wall
inlet_fillet = 4.0             # mm, inlet edge rounding
outlet_fillet = 2.0            # mm, outlet edge rounding
draft_angle_deg = 8.0          # deg, side-wall draft (taper)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build: profile the inlet rectangle, draft the walls to the smaller outlet,
# extrude along the axis and shell the body to a uniform thin wall.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as housing:
    # Inlet cross-section (workplane at the inlet face, z = 0)
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        Rectangle(inlet_width, inlet_height)

    # Draft the side walls inward so the far end becomes the smaller outlet,
    # then extrude the tapered body along the housing axis.
    extrude(amount=overall_length, taper=draft_angle_deg)

    # Hollow the body into an open-ended shell (both ends left open)
    shell(
        amount=-wall_thickness,
        openings=housing.faces().filter_by(Axis.Z),
    )

    # Round the inlet rim edges
    inlet_edges = [
        e
        for e in housing.edges()
        if e.center().Z < 1.0
        and abs(abs(e.center().X) - inlet_width / 2) < 1.0
        and abs(abs(e.center().Y) - inlet_height / 2) < 1.0
    ]
    fillet(inlet_edges, inlet_fillet)

    # Round the outlet rim edges
    outlet_edges = [
        e
        for e in housing.edges()
        if e.center().Z > overall_length - 1.0
        and abs(abs(e.center().X) - outlet_width / 2) < 1.0
        and abs(abs(e.center().Y) - outlet_height / 2) < 1.0
    ]
    fillet(outlet_edges, outlet_fillet)

part = housing.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions (mm)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
length = 80.0              # overall strap length
height = 12.0              # strap height (Y)
thickness = 6.0            # strap thickness (X)
bend_radius = 20.0         # bend radius of the S-curve
chamfer_len = 1.5          # chamfer on the long edges of the profile
hole_dia = 5.0             # through-hole diameter
hole_offset_x = 3.0        # hole centre distance from the side face
hole_offset_z = 40.0       # hole centre position along the strap

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Bend path : an S-curve running in the YZ plane, centred on the origin
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildLine() as path_builder:
    Spline(
        (0.0, 0.0, -length / 2.0),
        (bend_radius, 0.0, -length / 2.0 + length * 0.25),
        (-bend_radius, 0.0, length / 2.0 - length * 0.25),
        (0.0, 0.0, length / 2.0),
    )

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Cross-section profile (in the XY plane, centred on the path origin)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as profile_builder:
    Rectangle(thickness, height)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Sweep the profile along the S-path to create the bent strap
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as strap_builder:
    sweep(sections=profile_builder.sketch, path=path_builder.wire())

solid_body = strap_builder.part

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chamfer the long edges of the profile (parallel to the bend path)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
long_edges = solid_body.edges().filter_by(Axis.X)
solid_body = chamfer(long_edges, chamfer_len)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Drill the through hole, centred on the side face at mid-length
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
side_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.X)[-1]
face_center = side_face.center()
hole = Pos(face_center.X + hole_offset_x, face_center.Y, face_center.Z + hole_offset_z) * Cylinder(
    hole_dia / 2, thickness * 3, rotation=(0, 90, 0)
)
solid_body = solid_body - hole

part = solid_body
export_step(part, "output.step")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7-hole flanged manifold block
#   - central through bore
#   - six equally spaced branch bores on a bolt circle
#   - six matching flanged branch ports (flange = outer ring + boss)
#   - each branch port has a tapered inlet throat
#   - one branch port carries a threaded inlet (threaded boss + thread)
#   - small chamfer on the top rim edges
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

block_height = 30.0          # overall block height (mm)
central_bore_dia = 30.0      # central through bore
branch_bore_dia = 18.0       # six branch through bores
branch_bolt_radius = 30.0    # radial location of the six branch ports

flange_outer_dia = 26.0      # flange outer diameter
flange_inner_dia = 20.0      # flange inner diameter (bore + clearance)
flange_thickness = 3.0       # flange plate thickness
boss_height = 2.5            # raised boss height above flange plate

inlet_throat_len = 12.0      # tapered inlet throat length
inlet_throat_top_dia = 15.0  # throat diameter at the flange face
inlet_throat_bot_dia = 18.0  # throat diameter where it meets the bore

threaded_port_angle = 0.0    # which branch carries the threaded inlet
thread_dia = 13.0            # thread major diameter
thread_depth = 0.8           # thread profile depth
thread_pitch = 2.0           # thread pitch (mm)
thread_turns = 10            # number of thread turns
thread_len = thread_turns * thread_pitch

rim_chamfer = 1.0            # small chamfer on top rim edges

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # ---- central solid block (disc) ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        Circle(central_bore_dia / 2 + 25.0)
    extrude(amount=block_height)

    # ---- six flanged branch ports (flange ring + boss) ----
    for i in range(6):
        a = math.radians(i * 60.0)
        px = branch_bolt_radius * math.cos(a)
        py = branch_bolt_radius * math.sin(a)
        with Locations((px, py, 0)):
            with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
                Circle(flange_outer_dia / 2)
            extrude(amount=block_height)
            with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(block_height - flange_thickness)):
                Circle(flange_inner_dia / 2)
            extrude(amount=flange_thickness, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
            with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(block_height - flange_thickness)):
                Circle(flange_inner_dia / 2 - 1.0)
            extrude(amount=boss_height, mode=Mode.ADD)

    # ---- central through bore ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        Circle(central_bore_dia / 2)
    extrude(amount=block_height, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- six branch through bores ----
    for i in range(6):
        a = math.radians(i * 60.0)
        px = branch_bolt_radius * math.cos(a)
        py = branch_bolt_radius * math.sin(a)
        with Locations((px, py, 0)):
            with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
                Circle(branch_bore_dia / 2)
            extrude(amount=block_height, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- tapered inlet throats on all six ports ----
    for i in range(6):
        a = math.radians(i * 60.0)
        px = branch_bolt_radius * math.cos(a)
        py = branch_bolt_radius * math.sin(a)
        with Locations((px, py, block_height - flange_thickness)):
            with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
                Circle(inlet_throat_top_dia / 2)
            with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(-inlet_throat_len)):
                Circle(inlet_throat_bot_dia / 2)
            loft(mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- threaded inlet on the single designated port ----
    ta = math.radians(threaded_port_angle)
    tpx = branch_bolt_radius * math.cos(ta)
    tpy = branch_bolt_radius * math.sin(ta)

    # threaded boss standing on the flange face
    with Locations((tpx, tpy, 0)):
        with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(block_height - flange_thickness)):
            Circle(thread_dia / 2 + 1.0)
        extrude(amount=thread_len)

    # thread profile (square section) swept along a helix
    with BuildPart() as th:
        with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
            with Locations((thread_dia / 2, 0)):
                Rectangle(thread_depth, thread_pitch * 0.8)
        extrude(amount=thread_len, taper=360.0 * thread_turns)
    thread_solid = th.part
    thread_solid = Pos(tpx, tpy, block_height - flange_thickness) * thread_solid
    add(thread_solid)

    # ---- chamfer the top rim edges ----
    top_edges = p.edges().group_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
    chamfer(top_edges, length=rim_chamfer)

part = p.part

export_step(part, "output.step")
